nodes.label: Phase 2: Hard Setup Gate and Signed Repair
nodes.rationale: Phase 2 blocks normal application entry whenever any required runtime component is missing, unreadable, corrupt, or unusable, then lets the user explicitly consent to a trustworthy repair using only the exact running app version's official signed GitHub assets. It owns the setup gate, consent flow, signed repair service, safe generation activation, recovery, diagnostics, and automatic post-repair admission.

nodes.label: AD-19 Signed Release Trust and Repair
nodes.rationale: Approved architecture decision: cryptography==49.0.0; pure Ed25519 detached signatures; a compiled 32-byte raw public key represented as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; a 64-byte raw signature; exact-byte canonical manifest verification; exact release-version and schema checks; official origin https://github.com/pasttrunks/lecturepack/releases/download/v{app_version}/.

nodes.label: ReleaseTrustVerifier
nodes.rationale: Qt-free verifier that authenticates raw Ed25519 bytes before strict canonical parsing; exposes no network or installation behavior. Implements the fail-closed exact-byte release trust policy of AD-19.

nodes.label: ReleaseLayout
nodes.rationale: Immutable exact-version release layout and frozen accept/reject vector forming the test oracle for AD-19.

nodes.label: official_release_urls
nodes.rationale: Returns only https://github.com/pasttrunks/lecturepack/releases/download/v{app_version}/ with all six R1 exact filenames; exact-version fixed URLs replace release discovery and flexible asset selection.

nodes.label: ActiveGenerationResolver
nodes.rationale: Selects a complete verified writable generation while the portable bundle remains read-only (D-21; REPR-07). Single canonical resolver shared by bootstrap, diagnostics, packaged smoke, and repair.

nodes.label: resolve_active_runtime_root
nodes.rationale: The one canonical runtime-root resolver: absent pointer alone uses the immutable bundle, while malformed or interrupted pointer/journal is setup-required with diagnostic evidence (R4).

nodes.label: RuntimeGenerationStore
nodes.rationale: Durable writable runtime activation with atomic active-pointer publication and rollback-safe journal recovery; never writes repaired files into the immutable portable bundle.

nodes.label: safe_extract_verified_archive
nodes.rationale: Strict allow-listed streaming ZIP extraction with containment, member-shape, hash, and configured-size protection; never uses extractall or flattened component extraction.

nodes.label: RuntimeRepairService
nodes.rationale: Qt-free consent-gated repair coordinator: acquire → authenticate → stage → hash/inventory validate → activate safe boundary → assess(trigger='repair') → admitted/rollback. begin_repair_offer is the only pre-consent acquisition path.

nodes.label: RepairOperation
nodes.rationale: Operation-bound model: an unexpired matching authenticated offer must be confirmed before payload acquisition is possible; the offer is invalidated on cancel, terminal failure, retry, or changed admission state.

nodes.label: RepairEvent
nodes.rationale: Ordered JSON-safe event stream: started, progress, retrying, cancel_requested, cancelled/failed/activated/admitted, with exactly one matching terminal outcome (D-11, D-12, D-22; REPR-08).

nodes.label: RuntimeRepairWorker
nodes.rationale: QThread worker with explicit cancellation and JSON-safe repair_event signal; owns the worker lifecycle without Qt objects crossing the service boundary.

nodes.label: RuntimeSetupGateModel
nodes.rationale: Sole mutable runtime-gate lifecycle reducer with states gate|diagnostics|confirm|repairing|offline|failed|ready; filters stale/terminal events, keeps the app inert, and delays normal bridge activity until canonical admission permits it.

nodes.label: repair_event bridge signal
nodes.rationale: Bridge subscription exposing narrow begin-offer/confirm/cancel/retry/diagnostics repair commands while SETUP_REQUIRED; normal bridge operations remain guarded until canonical HEALTHY.

nodes.label: build_signed_runtime_release CLI
nodes.rationale: Release builder produces exactly the six AD-19 app-version assets (canonical Ed25519-signed manifest, raw .sig, and four ZIPs) consumed by ReleaseTrustVerifier; refuses inventory drift or noncanonical manifest bytes.

nodes.label: Tag-bound GitHub release workflow
nodes.rationale: Triggers on v* tag push and manual dispatch; peels refs/tags/v{app_version}^{commit} and compares exactly to HEAD before signing/publishing, and requires stripped tag, checked-out commit, manifest app_version, and version.py __version__ to agree. Keeps private key material out of repo/package/diagnostics/logs/artifacts.

nodes.label: R1 AD-19 release layout and member-to-component contract
nodes.rationale: Exactly six assets: manifest, .sig (both metadata-only) plus ffmpeg, whisper-cpu (incl. one-or-more ggml-cpu-*.dll), model-base-en, and smoke-fixture ZIPs; the four ZIPs always create one complete candidate generation restoring the canonical inventory.

nodes.label: R2 smoke fixture is runtime-required
nodes.rationale: smoke/runtime-smoke.wav is runtime-required, not validation-only; full admission stages it with models/ggml-base.en.bin and invokes whisper-cli.exe against it. Without it mandatory full admission cannot establish health.

nodes.label: R3 Authenticated metadata-before-consent and exact download size
nodes.rationale: Repair all issues only the fixed exact-version manifest and signature GETs before consent; download size is the exact checked decimal sum of the four signed ZIP size_bytes, never HTTP Content-Length, and no ZIP payload request occurs before Confirm & repair.

nodes.label: R4 Active-generation resolver, pointer/journal, and rollback contract
nodes.rationale: resolve_active_runtime_root(config) is the one canonical resolver; absent pointer returns immutable bundled root (first install); malformed/missing pointer or journal yields setup-required resolver error. active.json replace plus mandatory post-activation admission is the indivisible boundary.

nodes.label: cryptography==49.0.0
nodes.rationale: Locked by AD-19; Ed25519 API accepts raw 32-byte public bytes and verifies signature/data, raising on invalid signatures. Package legitimacy audit flagged it SUS (seam reported unknown downloads/no repository metadata) so a checkpoint:human-verify gate verifies the PyPI project and Windows wheel SHA-256 before use.

nodes.label: Exact-byte Ed25519 manifest verifier pattern
nodes.rationale: Authenticate raw manifest/signature bytes before interpretation: verify 64-byte detached signature against original response bytes, then decode UTF-8 and parse with duplicate-key/unknown-field/canonical checks. Signature-valid JSON is not enough if a tolerant parser accepts altered bytes.

nodes.label: Authenticated metadata-only repair offer
nodes.rationale: Selecting Repair all may acquire only the authenticated manifest and detached signature metadata before confirmation; it never requests archive payloads, stages, extracts, mutates the pointer, or activates a runtime until Confirm & repair (D-06, D-19, D-20; REPR-03/04).

nodes.label: Healthy-only collaborator construction
nodes.rationale: Adapters, updater, job activation, navigation, optional probing, and normal service access must not be constructed while runtime health is SETUP_REQUIRED; bridge creates adapter/updater exactly once only after canonical HEALTHY re-admission. Backend admission precedes construction of runtime-dependent services.

nodes.label: Deterministic setup-gate state machine and UI contract
nodes.rationale: Non-dismissible modal gate reusing beta-5 tokens (lp-scrim, lp-pop, lp-press, lp-fill, LP.motion, focus helpers); states gate|diagnostics|confirm|repairing|offline|failed|ready; one compositor scaleX progressbar; UI formats only the backend-authenticated four-archive byte total and never estimates download size.

nodes.label: Packaged UI evidence record
nodes.rationale: Verified and approved disposable packaged build evidence: 11/11 packaged tests green and 798 passed full suite; real repair under Unicode-and-space paths, damaged ffmpeg recovered via SETUP_REQUIRED → REPAIR → HEALTHY; every gate state, both themes, narrow/high-DPI, reduced motion, and input containment verified against the packaged executable.
